title: Feasible value is bounded by the optimum
statement: Let an encoded maximization problem have an algorithm that, on every valid instance, outputs a feasible solution and, whenever the instance's optimum is at least the specified optimum threshold, outputs a solution whose value is at least the specified output threshold. Then, for every valid instance, the algorithm's solution value is at most the instance's optimum.
hypotheses_covered: An algorithm satisfying the threshold-approximation property
The input is a valid instance
